summary: Closed the two T66 blockers and the major documentation defect on the auto-fetch floor. F-001: hasAttributeValue now compares the character-reference-DECODED attribute value, so the <input type=image> and <meta http-equiv=refresh> gates read what a renderer reads; fixed in the one helper both gates share, which is the class's single choke point. T66-gates gateBypasses 7 -> 0. F-002: the CommonMark description and label grammars were replaced by an unbounded bracket-depth scanner with a first-close fallback that keeps the change a strict superset of the old extraction, so the collapsed (![a][]), shortcut (![a]) and balanced-bracket (![a[b]c](URL)) image forms are now findings while all four LINK spellings stay released. T66-md-oracle bypasses 5 -> 0; T66-boundary hostileLeakingCount 7 -> 0, hostileFullyClosed 17 -> 24. F-003: the policies.md auto-fetch subsection and the module header were corrected in both directions - the markdown entry now names all four image spellings, the gate entries say the value is decoded, three context departures replace the one named, and ASCII case-insensitivity is stated with its measured component-markup carrier. A new T71-doc-parity probe checks the subsection against the detector mechanically: parity true over 33 covered, 23 released and 16 property rows. All eleven prior matrices are byte-identical, the benign corpus count is 16 before and 16 after with the same files and policy ids, and Part B flags the same 7 synthetic shapes. A quadratic bracket scan the first implementation introduced (207869 ms on a 200 KB run of '[') was found by a new perf probe and fixed to 36.6 ms before shipping; the patterns it replaces cost 42106 ms on the same input.
